name: lancelot
description: Answers search and retrieval queries against a local LanceDB database, using OpenAI embeddings when an API key is set and text search otherwise.

lancedb_path.title: LanceDB database folder
lancedb_path.description: Folder that holds your LanceDB database. Lancelot reads it and never writes to it.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Embeddings use this key when it is present. Text search runs when it is empty.
